svg.title: The engine owns the back stack
svg.desc: A step sends next from its own entry and njia pushes the step after it, while the host draws the top entry with a fade and a short slide. A late next from entry 1, which is no longer on top, is stale and moves nothing. With supportingSidePending set, the document segment repeats for the back, and back from entry 3 pops it.
svg.text: an intent, from its own entry
the back stack is plain state
